examples.english: The mine in which the accident took place is a mine owned by the Astur-Leonesa Mining Company, owned by businessman Rodolfo Cachero, which is located in the mining region of southwestern Asturias, on the border with León.
examples.ref: 2015 July 16, “Muere un minero tras un derrumbe en una mina de Asturias”, in El País:
examples.text: La mina en la que tuvo lugar el accidente es una explotación propiedad de la Minera Astur-Leonesa, del empresario Rodolfo Cachero, que se encuentra situada en la comarca minera del suroccidente de Asturias, en el límite con León.
examples.translation: The mine in which the accident took place is a mine owned by the Astur-Leonesa Mining Company, owned by businessman Rodolfo Cachero, which is located in the mining region of southwestern Asturias, on the border with León.
